question:
In this question, a statement is followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.

 

Statement:

The special task force set up by the government has found that toxic waste is being mixed with dry waste by many apartment complexes before collection by the municipality, causing severe danger to the waste processing personnel and the environment.

 

Courses of Action:

(I) Apartment complexes should be heavily penalised in instances where toxic and dry waste is not properly segregated before collection.

(II) Apartment complexes should issue clear guidelines on waste segregation to the apartment residents.
